teaser.en: Its name promises that whoever takes it will 'never fall sick' again.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linaahidi kwamba yeyote atakayeutumia 'hataugua kamwe' tena.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinalaga kukala yeyesi anayeuhumira 'kalumwa' tsona.

summary.en: *Kalumwa* is a forest climber with large lobed leaves and thick yellow roots, the calumba root of old pharmacy books. To the Digo it is a medicine for many ailments.
summary.sw: *Kalumwa* ni mtambaa wa msituni wenye majani makubwa yenye mapande na mizizi minene ya manjano, ile mizizi ya *calumba* inayotajwa katika vitabu vya zamani vya famasia. Kwa Wadigo ni dawa ya maradhi mengi.
summary.dg: *Kalumwa* ni mmea wa tsaka unaokpwera, wenye makodza makulu genye mala na mizi maziho ga rangi ya mandano, ambao ni *calumba root* ya vitabu vya kare vya dawa. Kpwa Adigo ni dawa ya makongo manji.

about.en:
*Kalumwa* is a climber with large leaves cut into several deep lobes, like an open hand. Below ground it forms clusters of thick, fleshy, tuberous roots that are bright yellow inside and intensely bitter.

Male and female flowers grow on separate plants, in long hanging sprays of small greenish flowers.
about.sw:
*Kalumwa* ni mtambaa wenye majani makubwa yaliyokatika kuwa mapande kadhaa marefu, kama kiganja kilicho wazi. Chini ya ardhi huunda mafungu ya mizizi minene yenye nyama, kama viazi, iliyo ya manjano angavu ndani na chungu mno.

Maua ya kiume na ya kike hukua kwenye mimea tofauti, katika mashada marefu yanayoning'inia ya maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani hafifu.
about.dg:
*Kalumwa* ni mmea unaokpwera wenye makodza makulu ganayokatika mala manji mare, dza mkpwono uriovugulika. Tsini ya ulongo unahenda mafungu ga mizi miziho, ya nyama nyinji, dza viazi, ambayo ndani ni ya rangi ya mandano inayong'ala na ina utsungu sana.

Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwenye mimea tafwauti, kpwenye mafungu mare ganayogbwadzika ga maruwa madide ga rangi ya chijani.

where.en: *Kalumwa* grows in coastal forest, climbing into the trees from the forest floor. Its big lobed leaves stand out among the smaller-leaved vines.
where.sw: *Kalumwa* hukua katika msitu wa pwani, ukipanda juu ya miti kutoka sakafu ya msitu. Majani yake makubwa yenye mapande hujitokeza wazi miongoni mwa mitambaa yenye majani madogo.
where.dg: *Kalumwa* unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, unakpwera mihini kula photsi ya tsaka. Makodzage makulu genye mala ganaonekana sana kahi ya mimea yanjina inayokpwera yenye makodza madide.

uses.en:
*Kalumwa* is used as a medicine for many ailments. The yellow roots are the part valued, and they are strongly bitter.

The same root, under the name calumba, was long exported from East Africa and used as a bitter tonic in Europe and India.
uses.sw:
*Kalumwa* hutumika kama dawa ya maradhi mengi. Mizizi ya manjano ndiyo sehemu inayothaminiwa, na ni chungu sana.

Mizizi hiyo hiyo, kwa jina *calumba*, iliuzwa nje kutoka Afrika Mashariki kwa muda mrefu na kutumika kama dawa chungu ya kuongeza nguvu huko Ulaya na India.
uses.dg:
*Kalumwa* nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya makongo manji. Mizi ya rangi ya mandano ndiyo seemu inayotogolwa, na ina utsungu sana.

Mizi iyo iyo, kpwa dzina ra *calumba*, kpwa muda mure yakala inaguzwa kondze ya Afrika ya Mashariki, na Ulaya na India yakala inahumirwa dza dawa ya utsungu ya kuenjereza nguvu.

culture.en: The name *kalumwa* means 'never fall sick'. It is said to be so effective that whoever uses it never falls ill again, a strong statement of the trust placed in this plant.
culture.sw: Jina *kalumwa* lina maana ya 'hataugua kamwe'. Inasemekana kuwa ni dawa yenye nguvu kiasi kwamba yeyote anayeitumia haugui tena, kauli nzito inayoonyesha imani waliyonayo watu kwa mmea huu.
culture.dg: Dzina *kalumwa* rina mana ya 'kalumwa tsona'. Nkugombwa kukala ni dawa yenye nguvu sana hata yeyesi anayeihumira kalumwa tsona, na ihi inaonyesa vira atu anavyouluphira mmea uhu.

names.en: Digo: *kalumwa*, a name shared with Swahili. English: calumba. Scientists call it *Jateorhiza palmata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kalumwa*, jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiswahili. Kiingereza: *calumba*. Wanasayansi huuita *Jateorhiza palmata*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *kalumwa*, dzina ambaro piya ni ra Chiswahili. Chingereza: *calumba*. Asayansi anauiha *Jateorhiza palmata*.

reason.en: Another climber of the moonseed family
reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine wa familia ya moonseed
reason.dg: *Chihumbohumbo*, mmea wanjina unaokpwera wa jamii ya *moonseed*

reason.en: Another climber valued as strong medicine
reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine unaothaminiwa kama dawa yenye nguvu
reason.dg: *Mwinika ndzovu*, mmea wanjina unaokpwera unaotogolwa dza dawa kali
*Golonje*, dawa yanjina ya Chidigo inayomendzwa sana

reason.en: Herb used in Digo medicine mixtures
reason.sw: Mmea unaotumika katika michanganyiko ya dawa za Kidigo
reason.dg: *Mvuga*, mmea unaohumirwa kpwenye michanganyiko ya dawa za Chidigo
